swing_highs_and_lows.description: Price levels where the market reversed direction, leaving behind significant swing points. These are the most visible and widely watched zones.
swing_highs_and_lows.identification: A swing high is a candle with at least 2 lower highs on each side. A swing low is a candle with at least 2 higher lows on each side.
swing_highs_and_lows.significance: Higher timeframe swing points carry more weight than lower timeframe ones.

consolidation_zones.description: Areas where price traded sideways for an extended period. The market agreed on value here, making these levels magnets for future price action.
consolidation_zones.identification: Look for regions where price oscillated within a range for 5+ candles before a breakout.
consolidation_zones.significance: Wider consolidations with more touches indicate stronger agreement on value and stronger future reactions.

round_numbers.description: Psychologically significant price levels ending in 00 or 000. Retail and institutional orders cluster here due to human cognitive anchoring.
round_numbers.significance: The rounder the number, the larger the psychological impact. Act as magnets and barriers.

volume_nodes.description: Price levels with exceptional historical trading volume identified through Volume Profile analysis. High-volume nodes (HVN) act as support/resistance; low-volume nodes (LVN) allow fast price movement.
volume_nodes.tools: Volume Profile, Market Profile, Point of Control (POC)
volume_nodes.significance: HVN: price tends to consolidate. LVN: price tends to accelerate through.

previous_structure.description: Prior highs and lows from higher timeframes that have not been revisited. These create memory in the market.
previous_structure.significance: The longer the zone has been untested, the more powerful the reaction upon return.

quality_scoring_matrix.description: Score each zone from 0 to 4 based on the criteria below. Higher score = higher-quality zone.

confluence_factors.score_4: 4+ confluence factors (Fibonacci + round number + volume node + trendline)

interpretation.5_8: Moderate zone — trade only with strong additional confirmation
interpretation.13_16: Exceptional zone — maximum position sizing justified

role_reversal.name: Polarity Principle
role_reversal.description: When a support level is broken convincingly, it transforms into resistance. When a resistance level is broken convincingly, it transforms into support. The market tests the broken level from the other side before continuing.
conditions_for_valid_role_reversal: Break must be decisive — at least a full candle body close beyond the zone
Volume should expand on the breakout candle
A retest of the broken zone from the new side confirms polarity flip
The zone holds during the retest (rejection candle from the new side)
role_reversal.failed_role_reversal: If price reverses back through the broken level, treat it as a false breakout and reassess direction.

zone_width.rationale: Crypto markets are volatile. A zone is not a line but a region. Using ±0.75% accounts for wicks, slippage, and exchange spread differences.
zone_width.application: If a zone is identified at 50000, the zone spans from 49625 to 50375.
zone_width.tighter_markets: For forex or equities, reduce to ±0.25% to ±0.50% depending on instrument volatility.
zone_width.never_use_exact_prices: Always define zones as bands, not single price points.

psychological_levels.description: Price levels that attract disproportionate order flow due to human psychology and institutional order placement practices.

types.option_strikes: Major options expiry levels concentrate open interest
types.all_time_highs_lows: Unique psychological barrier — no historical reference above/below
types.52_week_highs_lows: Institutional benchmark levels watched by funds

psychological_levels.behavior: Price often stalls at psychological levels even when no visible chart structure exists there. Combine with volume profile for confirmation.

rule_1_no_entry_in_the_middle.name: NO_ENTRY_IN_THE_MIDDLE
rule_1_no_entry_in_the_middle.statement: The agent must never initiate a trade when price is between a support and resistance zone. Entries are only permitted at defined zone boundaries — at support or at resistance, never in the open space between them.
rule_1_no_entry_in_the_middle.rationale: Mid-range entries have undefined risk and poor reward-to-risk profiles.

rule_2_zone_freshness_priority.name: ZONE_FRESHNESS_PRIORITY
rule_2_zone_freshness_priority.statement: A zone that has been tested and held recently is weaker than a zone that has not been visited in a long time. The agent must assign lower confidence to recently-tested zones and higher confidence to untested or long-undisturbed zones.
rule_2_zone_freshness_priority.rationale: Each test of a zone absorbs pending orders. Fewer orders remain for future reactions.

rule_3_higher_timeframe_dominance.name: HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_DOMINANCE
rule_3_higher_timeframe_dominance.statement: When a lower timeframe zone conflicts with a higher timeframe zone, the higher timeframe zone takes precedence. The agent must not take counter-trend trades at lower timeframe zones that sit inside higher timeframe zones pointing the opposite direction.
rule_3_higher_timeframe_dominance.rationale: Higher timeframe participants have larger order sizes and move markets more significantly.

rule_4_minimum_quality_score.name: MINIMUM_QUALITY_SCORE
rule_4_minimum_quality_score.statement: The agent must not generate a trade signal at any zone with a quality score below 5 out of 16. Zones scoring 5-8 require an additional confirmation signal (e.g., bullish/bearish engulfing candle) before a signal is issued.
rule_4_minimum_quality_score.rationale: Low-quality zones produce low-probability trades that erode expectancy over time.

rule_5_polarity_confirmation_required.name: POLARITY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED
rule_5_polarity_confirmation_required.statement: When trading a role-reversed zone, the agent must not enter on the breakout candle itself. It must wait for a retest of the broken level from the new side and confirmation that the level is holding in its new role before issuing a signal.
rule_5_polarity_confirmation_required.rationale: False breakouts are common. Waiting for retest confirmation filters out low-probability breakout trades.

rule_6_zone_width_enforcement.name: ZONE_WIDTH_ENFORCEMENT
rule_6_zone_width_enforcement.statement: All zones must be stored and evaluated as ±0.75% bands, not single price lines. The agent must flag any analysis that references an exact price as a support or resistance without a defined width.
rule_6_zone_width_enforcement.rationale: Precision illusion (treating a zone as a single price) causes premature entry and stop-loss placement errors.

rule_7_psychological_level_markup.name: PSYCHOLOGICAL_LEVEL_MARKUP
rule_7_psychological_level_markup.statement: When a technical zone coincides with a round number (century or millennium), the agent must add +1 to the zone quality score and note the confluence explicitly in the reasoning trace.
rule_7_psychological_level_markup.rationale: Institutional order flow clusters at round numbers, increasing zone reliability.
